pages.text: Four long bridges lead from the landing to the four trial islands, each a day's labour: Solenne's Sun Spire (east), Vael's Moon Arena (west), Orrin's Prism Observatory (south) and Ilyra's Endless Library (north). The Watchers wait at the bridge ends - speak to one to begin its trial.$(br2)Each completed trial grants that Watcher's $(l)Mark$() and its $(l)favour$() – but rival Watchers grow cooler: Solenne and Vael, Orrin and Ilyra.
